newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Life buys into Banca Del Gottardo. [CORRECTED 11:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Swiss Life buys into Banca Del Gottardo. [CORRECTED 11:00 GMT]

text.p: Insurer Swiss Life has bought four percent of shares in Banca del Gottardo, a Swiss bank majority owned by Japan's Sumitomo Bank, Banca del Gottardo said.
"This transaction will favour new business opportunities between the two institutions," Gottardo said in a statement from its headquarters in Lugano in Italian-speaking southern Switzerland.
It did not elaborate on the business opportunities.

Last year, Sumitomo raised its stake in Gottardo to 58 percent of voting share capital and 46 percent of participatory capital from an earlier 55 percent of voting share capital and 12 percent of participatory capital.
Banca del Gottardo is a trading and private bank whose main income comes from commissions from portfolio management, securities trading and syndicate and new issue business.
Gottardo had a balance sheet of 9.085 billion Swiss francs at the end of 1995 and net profit of 53.7 million.
Swiss Life's 1995 balance sheet was 73.6 billion francs and net profit 1.3 billion.
